OpenSeadragon 4.1.1 (built 2024-04-01), vendored unmodified.

It is the deep-zoom viewer of the public project page (js/components/deep-zoom.js), loaded only when a visitor opens
"Explore full resolution". It is served from this origin, so the site's Content-Security-Policy (script-src 'self') needs
no exception; the file makes no network request of its own beyond the image tiles it is asked for. The source map the
file's last line names is not shipped.

To update: download the new version from npm, replace openseadragon.min.js and LICENSE.txt, update this file (version,
date, both hashes) and OSD_VERSION in js/deep-zoom.js, and run `node --test` and `node scripts/browser-smoke.mjs`.
